• Brand introduction: TOWILD Illuminating freedom! Passionate about cycling and nature, we create high-quality, smart bike lights for safety and adventure. Our team of avid riders understands the challenges of night cycling. With innovative technology, we offer convenient, reliable lighting solutions. Join us on the road to freedom!
• Product description:Bike Lights for Night Riding Bike Light Set Compatibility with Brompton,500 Lumens Bike Front Light USB-C Rechargeable Waterproof Bicycle Headlight 
• USP (Unique Selling Point): 

  • Optimal Visibility for City Commuters: Specifically designed for Brompton bikes, this bike front light delivers 800 lumens of brightness, illuminating up to 200 meters. Perfect for city commuting, it ensures you're visible in all conditions, enhancing safety for early morning or late-night rides.
  • Sturdy Fork Mount for Urban Adventures: This high-quality aluminum alloy front fork mount provides a secure, vibration-free installation. Compatible for Brompton bikes, it ensures stability on rough city terrains, making it ideal for urban explorers.
  • Convenient Light operation: It ensures you can adjust your lighting without taking your hands off the handlebars, perfect for efficiency-minded commuters navigating city traffic.
  • Long-lasting Battery for Daily Commuting: The 5000mAh rechargeable battery offers up to 6 hours of high brightness and 20 hours on low. Ideal for long days or weekend activities, it provides consistent illumination, catering to eco-conscious cyclists who prefer biking over driving.
  • Weather-resistant Design for All Conditions: With an IPX6 waterproof rating, this front light withstands all weather conditions. Whether in rain or shine, it performs reliably, making it perfect for eco-conscious commuters riding in all weather to reduce their carbon footprint.
  • Easy Installation and Seamless Integration: Designed for easy installation, the universal bracket fits Brompton bikes perfectly. All necessary components are included, allowing you to install it in just 10 minutes.


• Payment terms: PayPal and credit cards.
